compos.summarization: This smartphone UI screen is part of an app related to the "Mayan chart." The main content of this screen is a date selection dialog for setting a birthday. The dialog is titled "MOTHER'S BIRTHDAY" and displays a calendar for May 1927, with May 10th highlighted. Users can navigate through the calendar to select a specific date. There are two buttons at the bottom of the dialog: "CANCEL" to dismiss the dialog without making a selection, and "OK" to confirm the selected date. The background of the screen shows a partially visible section with additional content and an advertisement for an app called "Mirror no ads."
